a.lede: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.
a.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says

b.lede: The country’s prime minister expressed disappointment at being informed of the hack only via email. Now Australia is investigating whether OpenAI broke the law.
b.title: An OpenAI Agent Hacked Australia’s Health Service. Their Government Found Out Months Later
